summary: Milestone 2026.05.123 retrospective complete. 8 of 13 tasks completed; 4 blocked by conductor pre-gate artifact field name mismatches (rkan_ready vs exact_rational_forward_pass_ready; scorer_ready vs ebcn_scorer_ready). The two root gate failures cascaded into four blocked experiments. Core research goals were substantially achieved: RKAN exact-rational forward pass (fractions.Fraction, bit-identical), EBCN dual-head scorer (energy gap 2.37 on synthetic contradictions), sparse KAN clustering (1.88x memory compression), FR-11 CerCE scale (positive utility delta, no forgetting), DCCD multi-hop (58.3% chain valid rate), HumanEval NSVIF DSL compilation, and context-sensitive constraint induction (8 high-confidence candidates). Z3 bridge, EBCN SOTA validation, and hardware RKAN accounting all blocked by gate mismatch.

bottlenecks_identified: Gate field name mismatches: 4 experiments blocked by two naming discrepancies (rkan_ready vs exact_rational_forward_pass_ready; scorer_ready vs ebcn_scorer_ready)
Cascading gate failures: each root mismatch blocked 2 downstream experiments, so 2 naming bugs became 4 blocked tasks
No gate smoke-test at roadmap authoring time to validate that upstream artifacts would actually emit the referenced field names
improvements_suggested: Add a roadmap validation step that cross-checks gate field names against actual artifact outputs from completed experiments before launching downstream tasks
Standardize gate field naming: prefer the experiment ID prefix + _ready suffix pattern (rkan_ready, ebcn_scorer_ready) consistently in both artifact schema and roadmap YAML
For the next milestone: carry forward exp1605, exp1610, exp1611, exp1612 with corrected gate field names after aliasing or renaming the artifact fields
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Patch rkan.py to emit rkan_ready=true alongside exact_rational_forward_pass_ready so gate checks pass without roadmap edits
Patch EBCN scorer to emit scorer_ready=true alongside ebcn_scorer_ready so gate checks pass
Add a conductor-level gate field validation step that flags missing artifact fields at pre-gate time with a human-readable error naming both the expected field and the actual fields present
meta_reflection: The milestone achieved its core research goals across formal verification (RKAN), energy-based coherence (EBCN), constraint compression (sparse KAN), and continuous self-learning (CerCE FR-11), but lost 4 of 13 task slots to a preventable naming-mismatch pattern. The pattern is distinct from the legacy-gate-churn issue in prior milestones — these are new experiments with new artifacts where the roadmap author and the experiment implementer used different field name conventions. The fix is low-cost (alias the fields or update the gates) but the detection should be mechanical, not human. A gate smoke-test at roadmap activation time would catch this class of failure at zero execution cost.

rkan.finding: Exact rational KAN forward pass using fractions.Fraction achieves bit-identical outputs across repeated evaluations; reference energy 79/36 on test input

ebcn_scorer.finding: Dual-head attention EBCN scorer achieves energy gap 2.37 between consistent (mean 0.082) and contradictory (mean 2.45) logical traces; false accept rate 0.0 on 4-case synthetic suite

sparse_kan.finding: Global Group Lasso penalty achieves 1.88x memory compression (192 -> 102 bytes), 25% sparsity ratio, reconstruction loss 2.7e-4

dccd_multihop.finding: DCCD structural constraints injected across 12 multi-hop questions; chain valid rate 58.3%; draft mismatch rate consistent with structural constraint enforcement

fr11_cerce.finding: FR-11 CerCE scale over 1000 examples with positive utility delta and no certificate violations; continuous_self_learning_task satisfied

context_induction.finding: 8 context-sensitive constraint candidates generated from 68 failure log rows; highest confidence 0.923 (runtime_contract acquisition_path family)
